status: predeclared synthetic contract experiment; not a new held-out music evaluation
task: Predict one event duration, without splitting or rounding events

prior.type: uniform over the fixed common support

comparison: Bijective labels for the same outcomes must yield identical per-event likelihood, support coverage and seeded generated tick sequences. This is representation equivalence, not a superior musical model.
coarse_control: Sixteenth-only durations are a restricted-support baseline. Report exact coverage and excluded outcomes; do not compare its finite conditional NLL to the full-support NLL or round excluded events.
unknown_policy: Unseen representable duration gets positive prior mass; incompatible denominator, zero, negative and over-limit durations rejected explicitly. No UNK token is converted into an arbitrary duration.
generation: Condition on positive durations fitting the remaining exact target length; record this as constrained distribution. Do not score held-out targets with target-dependent remaining-length masks unless the same information is supplied to all models.
future_corpus_protocol: Freeze support, training-only counts, source-family split, prior and generation constraints before opening any genuinely unobserved eligible source. Report out-of-support rate separately; do not tune the support from test durations.
nonclaims: runtime superiority from serialized byte size
